# GovHub

> AI proposal writing platform built for government contractors. Drafts, reviews, and formats federal, state, and local RFP responses with awareness of Section L/M structure, FAR/DFARS clauses, and Section 508 conformance. Built for solo consultants, small-business contractors (8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, HUBZone), and system integrators.

## Product

- [AI proposal generator](https://www.govhub.online/solutions/ai-proposal-generator/): Drafts government RFP responses from the solicitation and your knowledge base.
- [Compliance matrix generator](https://www.govhub.online/solutions/compliance-matrix-generator/): Free tool — turns RFP text into a Section L/M compliance matrix you can export.
- [RFP shredding](https://www.govhub.online/solutions/rfp-shredding/): Extracts every requirement, instruction, and evaluation factor from a solicitation.
- [Form autofiller](https://www.govhub.online/solutions/form-autofiller/): SF-33, SF-1449, SF330, reps & certs autofilled from a shared company profile.
- [SF330 software](https://www.govhub.online/solutions/sf330/): Automates the SF330 architect-engineer qualifications form.
- [Technical writer review](https://www.govhub.online/solutions/technical-writer-review/): Automated review for compliance drift and evaluation-criteria alignment.
- [Template generator](https://www.govhub.online/solutions/template-generator/): Compliant response templates and formatting.
- [Solutions overview](https://www.govhub.online/solutions/)
- [Pricing](https://www.govhub.online/pricing/): Plans for solo contractors, small businesses, and system integrators; 14-day free trial.

## For

- [Small business contractors](https://www.govhub.online/for/small-business-contractors/): Win federal work without hiring a proposal team.
- [System integrators](https://www.govhub.online/for/system-integrators/): Coordinate multi-team pursuits without losing days to formatting.

## Data (GovHub Insights)

Free federal contract market data from USAspending.gov, refreshed weekly: spending by industry, agency, state, and set-aside program, plus contractor profiles and upcoming recompetes. Every figure is computed from public award data — see the methodology page for definitions and caveats.

- [Insights hub](https://www.govhub.online/insights/): Every dashboard — markets by NAICS code, agencies, states, set-asides, and top contractors.
- [Methodology](https://www.govhub.online/insights/methodology/): How the numbers are computed, what obligations mean, and known reporting caveats.
- [Top government contractors](https://www.govhub.online/insights/top-government-contractors/): The largest federal contractors by obligations this fiscal year.
- [Expiring federal contracts (recompete watch)](https://www.govhub.online/insights/expiring-federal-contracts/): The largest contracts ending in the next 12 months, by incumbent, agency, and market.
- [Federal spending by agency](https://www.govhub.online/insights/federal-spending-by-agency/): Which agencies obligate the most on contracts.
- [Federal spending by state](https://www.govhub.online/insights/federal-spending-by-state/): Where federal contract dollars land, with a state-by-state map.
- [Government contracts by NAICS](https://www.govhub.online/insights/government-contracts-by-naics/): The largest federal contract markets by industry code, linking each market dashboard.
- [Fastest-growing federal markets](https://www.govhub.online/insights/fastest-growing-federal-markets/): Same-period year-over-year growth by industry.
- [Top small-business contractors](https://www.govhub.online/insights/top-small-business-government-contractors/): The largest small-business federal contractors.
- [Largest federal contracts](https://www.govhub.online/insights/largest-federal-contracts-fy2026/): The biggest contracts by total award value active this year.
- [Weekly reports](https://www.govhub.online/insights/reports/): Dated weekly snapshots of newly reported contract activity (RSS available).

Vendor profiles live at /insights/vendor/{company}/ (top agencies, markets, largest awards, and expiring contracts per contractor); market dashboards at /insights/naics/{code}/, /insights/agency/{agency}/, /insights/state/{state}/, and /insights/set-aside/{program}/.
